name: AWS Braket Connector
description: Execute quantum circuits on AWS Braket quantum devices and simulators.

properties.label: Operation
properties.description: Choose Submit Task to queue a new quantum task. Choose Get Task Result to check the status of a previously submitted task — use this inside a BPMN polling loop with a timer to avoid long-running connector threads.

properties.label: AWS Session Token
properties.description: Optional. Required when using temporary credentials (e.g. from STS AssumeRole). Use a Camunda secret: {{secrets.AWS_SESSION_TOKEN}}

properties.label: AWS Region
properties.description: AWS region where your Braket tasks will run, e.g. us-east-1

properties.label: Task ARN
properties.description: ARN of the previously submitted Braket quantum task to check

properties.label: Device ARN
properties.description:
Full ARN of the target quantum device. Examples:
arn:aws:braket:::device/quantum-simulator/amazon/sv1 (SV1 simulator)
arn:aws:braket:us-east-1::device/qpu/ionq/Aria-1 (IonQ Aria QPU)

properties.label: Circuit Input Mode
properties.description: How the quantum circuit is supplied. Use OpenQASM to enter a circuit string directly, or Direct Params for full control over the Braket IR action payload.

properties.label: Quantum Circuit (OpenQASM 3)
properties.description: OpenQASM 3 circuit to execute. Braket does not transpile — use gates supported by the target device. Example: OPENQASM 3.0; qubit[1] q; bit[1] c; h q[0]; c[0] = measure q[0];

properties.label: Shots
properties.description: Number of circuit repetitions. Simulators support up to 100,000 shots; QPU limits vary by device.

properties.label: Braket IR Action (JSON)
properties.description:
Complete Braket IR action JSON string. Must include a valid braketSchemaHeader and source field. Example:
{"braketSchemaHeader":{"name":"braket.ir.openqasm.program","version":"1"},"source":"OPENQASM 3.0; ...","inputs":{}}

properties.label: S3 Result Bucket
properties.description: S3 bucket where Braket writes task results. Must be in the same AWS region as the task.

properties.label: S3 Key Prefix
properties.description: Key prefix within the S3 bucket for result objects. Braket appends /<taskId>/results.json automatically.

properties.label: Wait for Result
properties.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal state before completing the task. Keep this disabled (default) and use Get Task Result in a BPMN timer loop — enabling it risks a Camunda job worker timeout while waiting for QPU queue times that can exceed several minutes.

properties.label: Timeout (seconds)
properties.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a result before failing

properties.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
properties.description: How often to check the task status when waiting for a result

properties.label: Result Variable
properties.description: Name of the process variable to store the connector result

properties.label: Result Expression
properties.description: FEEL expression to map the result into process variables
properties.value: = {taskArn: response.taskArn, status: response.status, result: response.result, resultS3Uri: response.resultS3Uri}

properties.label: Error Expression
properties.description: FEEL expression to handle connector errors as BPMN errors
